limits: P1 now has its own A2.02 enclosure and all fourteen modeled P1 openings have plan jamb evidence. The open ventilation shaft, external planters/trellises, parking ramp, structural slab design and below-grade wall sections are not modeled or verified.

The southeast R5 corner and adjoining openings are provisionally reconciled. The long east line and south baseline retain inherited registration; the final south MO/MU split is provisional. Other R5 local steps, including the southwest terrace/enclosure boundary, still need a separate full-footprint audit.

North R2-R5 geometry is unchanged from revision 04. The diagnostic maximum horizontal center discrepancy remains 42.443 overview-raster pixels; six windows per floor does not establish dimensional alignment. R1 north entries still need audit.
